name: Blue Skunk Live Resin 1g
description: Introducing Blue Skunk Live Resin, a harmonious fusion born from the genetic union of Blueberry and Skunk #1.The enchanting Blueberry parentage imparts a luscious sweetness, reminiscent of ripe berries plucked under a summer sky. This delightful note is skillfully intertwined with the earthy and skunky undertones inherited from the legendary Skunk #1, creating a complex aroma profile that captivates the senses from the first encounter.
